name: tracker-launcher-history-config
goal: Native Tracker launches honor run history, routing and run-limit config, in-place projects and the retired gpt-6.1-sol model (7rd5ap)

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Native dispatch ignored the configured ladder, run history, run limits and in-place project routes. Reserved Sol rows retained the retired model. See specification/tracker-native-service.md.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing isolated picker and host tests missed dispatch composition. The host launch configuration, in-place launcher and queued Sol tests exercise the affected boundaries.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Product commit f5d0abf71d applied routing history, host config and working-directory behavior.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same nine recorded regressions passed on product fix commit f5d0abf71d.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
